Tool calling needs SGLang with the minicpm5 tool-call parser (sgl-project/sglang#25600). The openbmb cookbook says to install SGLang from main because v0.5.12.post1 lacked it; the PyPI 0.5.20 wheel used here ships it, so no source build is needed any more. The model writes XML tool calls (<function name="x"><param name="k">v</param></function>) and they come back as OpenAI tool_calls with finish_reason tool_calls, with thinking on and off.

SGLang has no MiniCPM5 reasoning parser, but the model uses plain <think> ... </think>, so --reasoning-parser qwen3 splits it into reasoning_content. With enable_thinking left unset the template adds no <think> prefix; the model opens the tag itself and the qwen3 parser still catches it.

flashinfer JIT-compiles its prefill kernels on the first request and shells out to ninja. In a venv that is not activated the first prefill dies with FileNotFoundError: ninja and the scheduler exits; put the venv bin directory on PATH before starting the server.
In a llama.cpp deployment the card warns that the default min_p 0.05 causes repetition and asks for min_p 0; the SGLang default min_p is already 0.

SGLang 0.5.20 from PyPI in a Python 3.12 venv (uv) with torch 2.13.0+cu130, flashinfer-python 0.6.18, sglang-kernel 0.4.7, triton 3.7.1, transformers 5.12.1, xgrammar 0.2.1; CUDA 13.0, driver 580.173.02, Ubuntu 24.04.4, kernel 6.17.0-1029-nvidia. Environment SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1 and SGLANG_DISABLE_CUDNN_CHECK=1 as the MiniCPM SGLang cookbook recommends, the venv bin directory on PATH (flashinfer JIT needs ninja). Server flags follow the openbmb SGLang cookbook (docs/deployment/sglang.md): --dtype bfloat16 --context-length 131072 --tool-call-parser minicpm5, plus --reasoning-parser qwen3 so the <think> block lands in reasoning_content; --mem-fraction-static 0.75 instead of the cookbook 0.85 to leave the unified-memory box about 20 GB of host headroom (the KV pool still holds about 2 million tokens). Radix prefix cache, chunked prefill 8192, CUDA graphs and the flashinfer attention backend are SGLang defaults. Every request sets temperature 0 and seed 42 as the workloads specify. The chat template has three thinking states: enable_thinking true prefills <think>, false prefills an empty think block, and unset lets the model decide, which on almost every prompt means it thinks. Speed and long-context depth rows send chat_template_kwargs enable_thinking false; eval and needle rows leave it unset (the template default).
